Q: Controller traceId is lost when queue/dequeue PropagationContext in BackgroundService (.NET 8) A:

MyApp.Publisher is missing from your AddSource list, so the SDK doesn't have an ActivityListener for it. I'd add the exact name:

tracingBuilder
    .AddSource("My.Publishers", "My.BgJobs", "My.Controllers.TestController", "MyApp.Publisher");

Normally, an unregistered source returns null and Activity.Current stays as ProcessItem. But your logs show a fresh @tr, which suggests the publisher span is being sampled by another listener. Dynatrace captures OpenTelemetry spans independently of your TracerProvider. So once the SDK listens for that source, StartActivity will use the ambient ProcessItem as the parent and keep the original TraceId.

Q: How do I get each unique value (not combination) to appear at least once? A:

You can use GENERATE_SERIES (since 2022) to create a tally and LEFT JOIN you numbered data to it. For example

select null ClientID, Gender.t FM_GenderID, Indigenous.t FM_IndigenousID
from GENERATE_SERIES(1, 1000) gs
left join (
  select row_number() over(order by t) id, t
  from (VALUES (1), (2), (3), (4)) AS x(t)
) Gender
on gs.value = Gender.id
left join (
  select row_number() over(order by t) id, t
  from (VALUES (1), (2), (4), (5), (6)) AS x(t)
) Indigenous
on gs.value = Indigenous.id

etc. 1000 stands for max length of your dimension.

Q: Are object URLs now cached on disk instead of memory only? A:

Yes it's still important to revoke your blob:// URLs when the Blob's data isn't needed anymore. They're still pointers to the Blob's data, and even disk storage isn't infinite.

My comment was about a case of reusing the same data. In that particular case it might make more sense to keep the blob:// URLs alive and reuse it instead of fetching the same data, generating a new Blob from it and create a new blob:// URL every time.

Q: Advanced App Clip Experience not appearing in Safari, while Default App Clip URL works A:

If you're typing or pasting https://app.example.com/demo/clip into the Safari address bar, the App Clip card won't show up. That's just how Safari works. It suppresses the handoff for direct address-bar navigation and just loads the webpage instead.

So, it's not an AASA or validation bug. The card only appears when a URL is tapped from another app like Messages, Mail, or Notes, or through the Smart App Banner on the page. I'd bet your Default link works because it's being shared and tapped, while you're testing the Advanced URL by typing it.

To test it:

  1. Paste the URL into Notes and tap it there.
  2. Clear the cache at Settings > Developer > Clear Experience Cache.
  3. Make sure App Store Connect says PUBLISHED rather than Received.

Apple's CDN can take 24+ hours to propagate these changes, so you might just need to wait.
